_meta.method: Every value was read from the rendered source PDF pages (provider-data/*.pdf). Nothing is guessed. Images are embedded photos extracted from the PDFs; Instagram screenshots, text blocks, broken image slots and duplicates were excluded.

status_values.verified: Confirmed by a real verification step (none yet — no provider is 'verified').
status_values.source_only: Stated in the source PDF, not independently confirmed.
status_values.unverified: Present in the source but ambiguous / not clearly labelled.
status_values.missing: Not in the source. Shown as 'غير متوفر'.

_meta.price_policy: providers.price_from/to only when the source states a standing price. Time-bound or day-part offers are packages with is_offer=true, never the base price.
